nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Developmental normative models using Gaussian process regression (GPR) in the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit with fivefold cross-validation.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we calculated the normative models of development using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit [46] with the Gaussian process regression (GPR) method; Fivefold cross-validation was conducted to avoid over /uniFB01 tting and obtain optimal parameters.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional GMV asymmetry (laterality index) per ROI.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: the laterality index in each region for every subject was calculated as GMVleft /C0 GMVright ð GMVleft þ GMVright Þ = 2 , which is a commonly used formula for values with a range from -2 to 2.; GPR models of GMV asymmetry for each ROI were trained based on 247 TDs with age and sex as covariates.
